FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
Willow Creek Shopping Plaza operates as a retail shopping center located at 1234 Willow Creek Drive, Springfield, IL. Our facility is designed to host a diverse mix of tenants, including professional offices, boutique retail stores, and service-oriented businesses such as pharmacies and cafes, which provide steady foot traffic and a stable business environment. 

The plaza ensures a safe and welcoming atmosphere for customers by maintaining up-to-date fire suppression systems and comprehensive security measures, including security cameras and proper lighting. Regular maintenance is conducted to uphold property standards, avoiding any significant deferred maintenance issues. Additionally, we comply with all local safety regulations and building codes, ensuring our operations are aligned with community safety standards. 

We prioritize effective risk management practices, evident in our clean claims history, which reflects minimal prior losses and effective maintenance efforts. Our focus remains on continuing to enhance tenant viability and customer satisfaction through a well-managed shopping environment.
FIELDS.OTHER BUSINESSES OWNED: Willow Creek Professional Offices, Willow Creek Fitness Center, Willow Creek Cafe, Willow Creek Boutique
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On January 10, 2023, a slip-and-fall incident occurred at Willow Creek Shopping Plaza due to an icy sidewalk, resulting in a claim of $3,500 which was settled. Additionally, on March 15, 2023, minor water damage was reported in one of the retail units following heavy rain, leading to a claim of $1,500 that has been fully remediated.
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Standard Grade Safe - Class B, equipped with fire resistance and security features.
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Adequate perimeter fencing and regular security patrols are implemented to enhance safety and deter criminal activities at Willow Creek Shopping Plaza.
